# Les Essais by Benoit Malige

> Les Essais is a monthly printed correspondence of philosophical essays on the art of thinking for yourself, created, written and published by Benoit Malige (Benoît Malige), in the tradition of Montaigne's Essais.

- Author, creator and publisher: Benoit Malige (Benoît Malige) — https://www.benoitmalige.com/
- Format: a new printed essay mailed each full membership month, a digital issue, access to a members' community (The Symposium) and monthly live discussions.
- Related work by the same author: The Identity Tax, a book included with the Les Essais introduction — https://identity-tax.benoitmalige.com/

## Pages

- [Les Essais](https://me.benoitmalige.com/les-essais): overview of Les Essais by Benoit Malige and how to join.

## About the author

- [Benoit Malige](https://www.benoitmalige.com/): writer of The Second Life newsletter, The Identity Tax and Les Essais.
